description: Long applicant name, long alias list, a long arrest description and a long list of record-holding agencies, to exercise multi-line wrapping in the caption, the party block and the allegations. Court identity and protected fields stay blank.

partyData.petitionerName: MARIA-ANTONIETTA SAMPLE-EXAMPLE DE LA SYNTHETIC-TESTCASE, JR.
partyData.petitionerAddress: 0000 EXAMPLE BOULEVARD, APARTMENT 000, EXAMPLE CITY, KENTUCKY 00000
partyData.otherNamesUsed: MARIA A. SAMPLE; MARIA SAMPLE-EXAMPLE; M. A. DE LA SYNTHETIC-TESTCASE; MARIA ANTONIETTA SAMPLE EXAMPLE DE LA SYNTHETIC TESTCASE

chargeData.chargeDescription: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN DESCRIPTION — SYNTHETIC LONG TEST VALUE: the participant's account of what they were arrested for, written out at length in their own words so that the allegation paragraph wraps across several rendered lines and pushes the signature block onto a following page]
chargeData.arrestOffenseDescription: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN DESCRIPTION — SYNTHETIC LONG TEST VALUE: the participant's account of what they were arrested for, written out at length in their own words so that the allegation paragraph wraps across several rendered lines and pushes the signature block onto a following page]

screeningAnswers.segOffence: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN DESCRIPTION — SYNTHETIC LONG TEST VALUE, as above]
screeningAnswers.segDispositionType: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN STATEMENT OF FACT — all charges dismissed — NOT SUPPLIED, DERIVED OR INFERRED BY LEGALEASE]
screeningAnswers.segAlreadyExpunged: no — participant states the records are not expunged and states they are not eligible under KRS 431.076 or KRS 431.078
screeningAnswers.segAgencies: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN LIST — SYNTHETIC LONG TEST VALUE: the arresting agency, the county jail that booked them, the state police records division, the county sheriff's office and a second municipal department that assisted with the arrest, each named by the participant in their own words at sufficient length that the list wraps across several rendered lines]

partyDataFieldNote: partyData uses the PleadingRenderInput field names petitionerName / petitionerAddress / otherNamesUsed. The role label for this track is set by presentation.movantRole in the config (Movant on the void-and-seal tracks, Applicant on the KRS 17.142(2) application), not by the fixture key name.
